title: A2UI ShadCN Component Catalog
description: Unified catalog of 53 ShadCN UI components and controls for A2UI agents.

Accordion.description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.

Alert.description: Displays a callout for user attention with variant styles.

AlertDialog.description: A modal dialog that interrupts the user with important content and expects a response.

AspectRatio.description: Displays content within a desired ratio.

Avatar.description: An image element with a fallback for representing the user.

Badge.description: Displays a small badge or status pill.

Breadcrumb.description: Displays the path to the current resource using a hierarchy of links.

Button.description: Displays a button or component that looks like a button.

ButtonGroup.description: Groups closely related buttons together visually.

Calendar.description: A date picker calendar component that allows users to select days or ranges.

Card.description: Displays a card with header, title, description, content, and footer.

Carousel.description: A carousel with motion and swipe capabilities.

Chart.description: Displays charts and graphs (bar, line, pie, area) powered by Recharts.

Checkbox.description: A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.

Collapsible.description: An interactive component which can be expanded or collapsed.

Command.description: Fast, composable, unstyled command menu for searching and actions.

ContextMenu.description: Displays a menu to the user — such as a set of actions or functions — triggered by right click.

Dialog.description: A window overlaid on either the primary window or another dialog window.

Drawer.description: A drawer modal that slides up from the bottom of the screen.

DropdownMenu.description: Displays a menu to the user triggered by a button.

Empty.description: Displays an empty state container with icon, title, description, and call to action.

Field.description: A complete field wrapper providing label, input control, and helper/error descriptions.

Form.description: A form container with schema validation and field state management.

HoverCard.description: For sighted users to preview content available behind a link.

Input.description: Displays a form input field or a component that looks like an input field.

InputGroup.description: An input element grouped with prepended or appended icons, text, or buttons.

InputOTP.description: Accessible one-time password / PIN component with copy paste and numeric inputs.

Item.description: A generic list item container with media/icon, title, subtitle, and action slots.

Kbd.description: Displays a keyboard key or shortcut combination.

Label.description: Renders an accessible label associated with controls.

Menubar.description: A visually persistent menu common in desktop applications for quick access to commands.

NavigationMenu.description: A collection of links for navigating websites.

Pagination.description: Pagination with page navigation, next, previous and page number links.

Popover.description: Displays rich content in a portal, triggered by a button.

Progress.description: Displays an indicator showing the completion progress of a task.

RadioGroup.description: A set of checkable buttons—known as radio buttons—where no more than one can be checked.

Resizable.description: Accessible resizable panel groups and layouts with drag handles.

ScrollArea.description: Augments native scroll with custom cross-browser styling.

Select.description: Displays a list of options for the user to pick from—triggered by a button.

Sheet.description: Extends the Dialog component to display content that complements the screen from any side.

Sidebar.description: A composable, collapsible navigation sidebar component.

Skeleton.description: Use to show a placeholder while content is loading.

Slider.description: An input where the user selects a value from within a given range.

Sonner.description: An opinionated toast component for feedback notifications.

Spinner.description: Indicates an active indeterminate loading state.

Switch.description: A control that allows the user to toggle between checked and not checked.

Table.description: A responsive table component for structured tabular data.

Tabs.description: A set of layered sections of content—known as tab panels—that are displayed one at a time.

Textarea.description: Displays a form textarea or a component that looks like a textarea.

Toggle.description: A two-state button that can be either on or off.

ToggleGroup.description: A set of two-state buttons that can be toggled on or off.

Tooltip.description: A popup that displays information related to an element when the element receives keyboard focus or the mouse hovers over it.
